title: Riddersholm.Money currency definition file
description: The input to Riddersholm.Money.Generators: eng/iso-4217.json for the built-in ISO table, or any file a consumer opts in with <AdditionalFiles Include="..." RiddersholmCurrencies="true" />. The generator enforces the same rules and reports a violation as a build error (RMG001-RMG006).

source.description: Provenance, written by tools/Riddersholm.Money.DataSync. Ignored by the generator.

code.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code: three upper-case ASCII letters. Must be unique in the file.

numericCode.description: ISO 4217 numeric code, or 0 when the currency has none. Defaults to 0.

name.description: English display name. Defaults to the code.

symbol.description: Display symbol. Defaults to the code.

decimalDigits.description: ISO 4217 minor-unit digits (the exponent). Required: there is no safe default. ISO currencies use 0-4; registered currencies may use up to 28.

minorUnitsPerMajor.description: Minor units per major unit. Defaults to 10^decimalDigits, and must be given explicitly above 18 digits. 5 for MRU and MGA, 0 for currencies with no minor unit (XXX, XTS). When non-zero it must divide 10^decimalDigits.

cashDecimalDigits.description: Digits used for physical cash. Defaults to decimalDigits.

cashRoundingStep.description: Cash rounding step in last-place units of cashDecimalDigits: 5 for CHF (0.05), 50 for DKK (0.50). 0 and 1 both mean no special cash rounding. Defaults to 1.

withdrawn.description: When ISO withdrew the currency, as YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. The currency stays usable for historical amounts and its generated member is marked [Obsolete].

replacedBy.description: The currency that replaced a withdrawn one. Only valid together with withdrawn.
